home.title: INTERRUPT
home.subtitle: Pause the impulse. Change what happens next.
home.description: When an urge takes over, you don't have to act immediately. INTERRUPT helps you create a small gap between the impulse and the action.

behavior.title: What are you about to do?
behavior.subtitle: Choose what best describes the impulse.
behavior.otherPlaceholder: What are you about to do?

expectation.title: What are you hoping to get from it?
expectation.subtitle: There is usually something the impulse promises you.

nameIt.title: Name the urge
nameIt.instruction: Don't fight the urge. Describe it.
nameIt.firstPrompt: What are you feeling right now?
nameIt.secondPrompt: What is the urge telling you to do?

promise.title: Make a short promise
promise.intro: You don't have to decide what happens forever.
promise.durationQuestion: How long can you postpone acting on it?
promise.afterQuestion: What will you do during that time?

wave.title: Ride the wave
wave.instruction: An urge can rise, peak and fall without being acted on.
wave.locationPrompt: Where do you feel it most strongly?
wave.timerIntro: Stay with the sensation without acting on it.

delay.title: Delay the action
delay.instruction: You don't have to say no forever. Just don't act for the next 10 minutes.
delay.promise: For the next 10 minutes, I will not act on this urge.

fastForward.title: Fast-forward
fastForward.intro: Move beyond the immediate moment and imagine what happens next.
fastForward.tenMinutes: Imagine yourself 10 minutes after acting on the urge.
fastForward.tenPlaceholder: What would you probably feel or think?
fastForward.tomorrowPlaceholder: How might you feel about what happened?
fastForward.next: Now imagine the next time this happens.

changeScene.title: Change the scene
changeScene.step2: Leave the place where the urge started.
changeScene.step4: Stay there for two minutes before deciding what to do.

actualNeed.title: Find the actual need
actualNeed.intro: The behavior may not be the thing you actually need.
actualNeed.question: What do you need right now?

suggestions.rest: Give yourself a few minutes without demanding anything from yourself.
suggestions.connection: Contact someone or move toward another person.
suggestions.stimulation: Choose a deliberate activity that gives your brain something to engage with.
suggestions.comfort: Try to give yourself comfort directly rather than through the impulse.
suggestions.relief: Look for the source of pressure and reduce it, even slightly.
suggestions.control: Choose one small thing you can control right now.
suggestions.escape: Change your environment instead of escaping through the behavior.
suggestions.food: If you're hungry, eat something deliberately rather than automatically.
suggestions.money: Pause the purchase and decide whether the financial outcome is worth it.
suggestions.other: Name one concrete thing that would genuinely help right now.

breakChain.title: Break the chain
breakChain.question: What usually happens immediately before this impulse?
breakChain.result: You found a possible link in the chain.

twoFutures.title: Two possible futures
twoFutures.intro: Imagine two versions of the next few hours.
twoFutures.act: If you act on the urge:
twoFutures.dont: If you don't act on the urge:

switch90.title: Switch for 90 seconds
switch90.instruction: Give your attention something completely different for 90 seconds.
switch90.task1: Name five things you can see.
switch90.task3: Describe the room you're in in detail.
switch90.task4: Move your body and notice five physical sensations.

realityCheck.title: Reality check
realityCheck.question: What are you expecting this behavior to give you?
realityCheck.certainty: How certain are you that it will actually deliver that?
realityCheck.past: Has this behavior reliably delivered that in the past?

generic.title: Pause and notice
generic.instruction: Take a moment before deciding what to do next.

outcome.title: What happened?
outcome.subtitle: Choose what best describes the result.

messages.same: The urge stayed about the same.

insights.title: Your patterns
insights.subtitle: INTERRUPT learns from what happens over time.
insights.lastTime: Last time, this type of urge dropped from {before} to {after} with {intervention}.
insights.repeatedly: {intervention} has repeatedly reduced this type of urge for you.
insights.similar: You have reduced a similar urge with {intervention} before.
insights.noDecrease: You tried {intervention} before, but the urge did not decrease.
